en: Colorized vintage view of an organized campground or caravan park. Tents and several 1950s-style cars are parked on grassy plots along a dirt path leading to a small central service building with a covered veranda. Mature trees line both sides of the path, and a few people in casual summer clothing move around the campsite. The sky is bright blue with scattered clouds. No visible printed captions or border text appear on the image side.
